title: Khipu
tagline: Tie knotted cords that write numbers, Inca style.
how_to: Tap a band on a cord to tie a knot; switch to Untying to remove; try Challenge.
description: A khipu was a set of knotted cords the Inca used for accounting. Tap bands on the hanging cords to tie knots for ones, tens, hundreds and thousands. The gold sum cord on the right ties itself to the total. Try Challenge to tie target numbers.
spark: Knots became the writing system itself: numbers stored as knots.
proud_of: The sum cord re-ties its own knots live as you add to the others.
